# Paper Capability Session Start

Paper is an additive capability on the standard SMAIRT research workflow.

```text
Read smairt.yaml, paper/README.md, paper/outline.md, FINAL_MANIFEST.md, the current study
report if present, and every core analysis relevant to the manuscript section. Summarize
which claims are supported, which remain provisional, and which evidence links are missing.
Do not create a second research workflow or move source evidence into paper/.
```

Before drafting, verify the research question, strongest evidence, negative findings,
limitations, human contributions, and unresolved analyses.
